_comment: One-off mutation-testing AUDIT for the testability initiative (item 6, Element E). It locates weak L1 spots: surviving mutants = behaviour the suite never asserts. This is NOT a CI gate and is deliberately not wired into turbo / npm test / npm run check. Re-run it on demand with: npm run audit:mutation -w @hydranium/core (full core, ~3 min) or npm run audit:mutation:quick -w @hydranium/core (just model-service, ~10 s to sanity-check the setup). Equivalent raw form: npm exec --workspace=@hydranium/core -- stryker run [--mutate 'src/<path>']. Needs the @stryker-mutator/core + @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner devDeps. Output: an HTML report at packages/core/stryker-report/mutation.html plus a clear-text summary; both are gitignored. inPlace is required: core is a workspace package, so a copy-sandbox would resolve @hydranium/* through the real symlinked node_modules (unmutated) and the ../../vitest.shared import would be missing; inPlace mutates the real tree and restores it on completion.
